title: Nice, bathroom toothbrush and toothpaste holder
text: Nice, bathroom toothbrush and toothpaste holder. Nice, bathroom toothbrush and toothpaste holder.  It is simply plastic, but it does look nice on the counter and it does it's job, which is holding toothbrushes and toothpaste.  Much better than a tube of toothpaste being thrown in the drawer with toothpaste all over it.

product_metadata.title: iDesign InterDesign Bathroom Toothbrush and Toothpaste Stand/Holder and Organizer – White/Chrome York Dental Center
features: VERSATILE STORAGE – Dental Center combines storage for up to four toothbrushes and a tube of toothpaste in a single, easy-access unit; Also great for makeup brushes
SLIM PROFILE – Designed to fit onto counter tops or vanities without requiring a lot of space
DIVIDED COMPARTMENTS – Four-slotted umbrella keeps toothbrushes neatly separated; Divided base chambers prevent cleaning devices from shifting
DURABLE CONSTRUCTION – Made of durable plastic featuring a neutral white color scheme and chrome detailing at the base and along the storage umbrella
SPACE-EFFICIENT – Takes very little space on a counter top or vanity; Measures 5.84" Inches x 3.19" Inches x 4.50
description: InterDesign's York Dental Center is a convenient, space-efficient solution for storing dental hygiene necessities and supplies at the bathroom counter or vanity. It features divided compartments that hold up to four toothbrushes and a side compartment for a tube of toothpaste. A sturdy plastic construction is complemented by brushed details for a modern look.
